references.text: Isaiah describes how God's people will be known by their righteous deeds, which can be compared to recognizing a tree by the fruit it bears.
Micah warns against false prophets, and the idea of knowing them by their fruits may be seen as relevant here.
Paul lists the fruit of the Spirit, which are good qualities Christians should pursue and that can be used to recognize them by.
James uses a similar analogy that a fig tree cannot bear olives, or a vine figs, emphasizing that good deeds (fruits) are signs of a good character.
